prompt: 我手上有一个设计师交付的 500KB 单文件 SPA 原型（hash 路由，三个导航视图 chat/experts/projects，fixed 侧边栏布局），我改了 4 处：① 侧边栏 AI 对话导航加 NEW 徽章 ② 品牌区加版本号 ③ 专家团视图里「供应链经营总控」卡片加新技能徽章 ④ 项目组视图里「Q3 交付保障」卡片加里程碑徽章。请给这个原型做一个改动预览：打开文件先看到改动总览，点击任意一处能定位到改动处（包括需要先切换视图的子视图改动），评审可以勾选确认并复制 Markdown 清单。
assertions: The SPA has a fixed changes bar, default collapsed to one slim row under 40px tall
Collapsed bar shows 'N 处改动' verdict plus one clickable tag per change
Expanded bar shows per-change rows with summary + jump link + checkbox + copy-markdown
Each change is marked with an id=chg-N badge injected in the render template, surviving view switching
Jumping to a change in another sub-view clicks the nav and waits for render before locating
Locating uses flash animation + persistent outline, not hash anchors or scrollIntoView alone
Switching target clears the previous locate highlight
Original nav switching still works with zero console errors
